newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India shares stronger in heavy volume.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India shares stronger in heavy volume.

text.p: Indian global depository receipts closed higher Wednesday in heavy trading, building on a strong day in local markets.
"With the political situation behind us sentiment seems very positive," a trader said, noting that volume was among the heaviest in his experience.
Bombay's benchmark index closed up 66.74 points, or 1.73 percent, at 3,927.71.
"Once the psychologically important 4,000 point barrier is passed, which I think will happen soon, it will get firmer and firmer," a trader said.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 1.45 points up at 84.25, with the premium over the local market at 25.80 percent from 24.80 percent.
Reliance led GDRs higher, fuelled by rumours of a bonus share issue, traders said. Reliance jumped $1.12 to $20.88/$21.38. Bajaj Auto gained 81 cents to $33.50/$35.00.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index fell 1.12 points, or 1.49 percent, to 73.99 points, a premium of 41.73 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index fell 1.35 points, or 1.35 percent, to 119.30, representing a discount to the local market of 3.92 percent.
